title: Tender
description: Whenever you play a card, lose [blue]1[/blue] [gold]Strength[/gold] and [blue]1[/blue] [gold]Dexterity[/gold] this turn.
smart_description: Whenever you play a card, lose [blue]{Amount}[/blue] [gold]Strength[/gold] and [blue]{Amount}[/blue] [gold]Dexterity[/gold] this turn.
notes: At the end of the turn, the character also loses additional Strength and Dexterity equal to the number of cards played that turn. The counter tracks cards played this turn.
